title: Less EU money for farmers and regions, but a growing Ukraine bill: Leaders meet to square trillion-euro circles at special summit
lede: EU leaders are heading for a clash over the bloc’s next long-term budget, with deep divisions over its size, new revenue sources and funding for Ukraine. German chancellor Friedrich Merz is demanding that all 27 member states contribute to Kyiv’s needs, while several countries are seeking opt-outs.
